T: When somebody loved me, they fed me.
D: Woody is stolen by a toy collector and the gang sets out to rescue him.
P: Serve the cheese puffs when Al starts eating them in his apartment.
S: the orange dust on his fingers
Homemade cheese puffs: choux pastry with grated cheddar and gruyère, piped into rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed.
Beans simmered with smoked bacon, onion, molasses, mustard and tomato for 2 hours until thick and sticky. Cornbread squares.
Jessie's horse with the big goofy grin
Caramels melted with a splash of cream until smooth, crisp apple wedges patted dry and dipped halfway, rolled in crushed roasted peanuts and set on baking paper in the fridge for 20 minutes.
M: Al in his chicken suit on the TV ad
Drumsticks brined in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 75C inside. Coleslaw and corn.
Stinky Pete, still in his box
Beef chuck browned, onion, garlic, chipotle and cumin, tomatoes and beans, braised 3 hours. Sour cream and cornbread.
W: Jessie's cowgirl yodel on the old TV show
Butter sugar cookie dough chilled, rolled, cut into cowboy hats and boots, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced with red and white royal icing in Jessie's cowgirl colours.
K: Sarsaparilla poured over vanilla ice cream until it foams.

s.note: the orange dust on his fingers
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and cook a minute. Cool, beat in 2 eggs, then 50g grated cheddar and 40g gruyère. Pipe small rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed.

s.note: Jessie's horse with the big goofy grin
s.how: Melt 200g caramels with 2 tbsp cream until smooth. Cut 3 apples into wedges and pat dry. Dip halfway, roll in 60g crushed roasted peanuts and set on baking paper in the fridge for 20 minutes.

m.note: Stinky Pete, still in his box
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add an onion, 3 garlic cloves, 2 chipotles in adobo and 2 tsp cumin, then 2 tins tomatoes and 2 tins kidney beans. Braise 3 hours. Serve with sour cream and squares of cornbread.

w.note: Jessie's cowgirl yodel on the old TV show
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Chill, roll and cut into cowboy hats and boots. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice with 300g icing sugar mixed with egg white, some tinted red, in cowgirl colours.

d.how: Put two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Pour a 375ml can of sarsaparilla slowly down the side of each until it foams to the top. Serve with long spoons.
